faqs.q: What makes Garden Fresh different for restaurants?
faqs.a: Garden Fresh is built around chef workflows: split cases, standing orders, late cutoffs, no order minimums, no delivery fees, and local support from a Pompano Beach team.

faqs.a: Yes. Send your prep staples, weekly volume, delivery window, and seasonal items. We can build a practical online order guide for your kitchen.

faqs.q: Do you deliver to both Broward and Palm Beach Counties?
faqs.a: Yes. Garden Fresh runs refrigerated restaurant produce routes across Broward and Palm Beach Counties, with city pages for major local service areas.

faqs.q: Can I order specialty produce for menu changes?
faqs.a: Yes. Restaurants can request specialty mushrooms, microgreens, edible flowers, tropical fruit, organics, and seasonal produce when available.

name: Restaurants
card_blurb: Split cases, standing orders, late cutoffs, and 7-day refrigerated routes built around chef workflows.
intro: Garden Fresh is built around how restaurant kitchens actually run: orders placed after service ends, trucks dispatched at 4 AM, product in the walk-in before prep starts. We supply restaurants, cafes, bars, caterers, and private chefs across Broward and Palm Beach Counties with the full produce range — staples through specialty.

Split cases and by-the-pound options keep food cost honest. Standing orders hold your pars steady. There are no order minimums, no delivery fees, and no fuel charges on local routes — and when a menu changes at 10 PM, the cutoff for most next-day items is 12 AM.

groups.d: Place most orders by 12AM for next-day restaurant delivery.
Order cases, split cases, and by-the-pound items as menus change.
Set weekly pars for staple produce and add seasonal specials.
Work with a Pompano Beach team that understands chef timelines.

name: Yacht Provisioning
card_blurb: Dockside provisioning for yachts and crew from Fort Lauderdale to Palm Beach marinas.
intro: South Florida is the yachting capital of the world, and provisioning timelines are brutal: an owner arrives Friday, the boat leaves Sunday, and the galley needs restaurant-grade produce packed for a crossing. We provision yachts and crew kitchens from the marinas of Fort Lauderdale, Dania Beach, and Palm Beach with dock-side delivery timed to your departure.
Chief stews and galley chefs get hand-selected produce, pack-out suited to marine refrigeration, and a local team that answers the phone when plans change — because on charter, they always do.

groups.d: Plan day-one produce, herbs, salad items, citrus, berries, and guest-ready fruit for departure service.
Stage avocados, bananas, tomatoes, mangos, and other sensitive items for mid-trip and later use.
Use labeled crates, split cases, trimmed greens, and practical pack sizes for limited storage.
Provisioning scheduled to your departure window, packed for marine refrigeration and crossings.

name: Seasonal Produce
card_blurb: Plan specials around South Florida seasons — stone fruit summers, winter tomatoes, year-round tropicals.
intro: South Florida flips the seasons: our best local tomato and greens months are winter, summer brings mango and tropical fruit, and season (the human kind) doubles covers from November to April. We help chefs plan specials and menus around what is actually good right now — and around what their dining room volume is about to do.
Ask your rep what is peaking before you print the next menu. Seasonal items can ride alongside your standing staple order, in split cases while you test a special and full cases once it sells.

groups.d: Romaine, spring mix, spinach, kale, basil, parsley, cilantro, and mint.
Lemons, limes, oranges, mangos, pineapple, avocados, and seasonal fruit.
Potatoes, onions, carrots, beets, squash, peppers, mushrooms, and prep vegetables.
Microgreens, edible flowers, specialty mushrooms, organics, berries, and chef requests.
